metadata.title: Carista Molecular Diagnostic Operations Index
metadata.description: Direct binary-evidenced diagnostic operations decoupled from customization settings schema

operations.name: AutoScan / Gateway ECU Discovery

protocol_command.response_payload_parser: 4 bytes per installed ECU: [Byte 0: Logical Address (0x01=Engine, 0x02=Trans, 0x03=ABS, etc.), Byte 1: Status Mask, Byte 2: Bus Type, Byte 3: Protocol ID]

expected_nrc_handling.0x78: ResponsePending -> wait and poll up to 5000ms
expected_nrc_handling.0x31: RequestOutOfRange -> fallback to KWP2000 Gateway query 0x1A 0x9B

operations.rejection_note: MOLECULAR_AUDIT_ROUND2.md Bad Case 1: AutoScan is an ECU discovery operation, NOT a coding setting. Modeling it as VagUdsCodingSetting with dummy F1A3/byte0/mask1 is structurally prohibited.

target_ecu.name: BROADCAST_OR_PHYSICAL
target_ecu.addressing: Iterated across all installed ECUs discovered via 2204A1

protocol_command.response_payload_parser: Iterate 4-byte DTC records: [Byte 0-2: 3-byte DTC Code (e.g. 0x00A123), Byte 3: Status Mask (Bit 0: testFailed, Bit 2: pendingDTC, Bit 3: confirmedDTC)]

operations.name: Clear Diagnostic Trouble Codes (All Faults)
operations.rejection_note: MOLECULAR_AUDIT_ROUND2.md Bad Case 2: ClearDiagnosticInformation is an atomic UDS operation (0x14 FF FF FF), NOT a coding setting.
